name: Depth-Guided NeRF Training via Earth Mover’s Distance
aliases: Depth-guided NeRF Training via Earth Mover’s Distance
Depth-guided NeRF via Earth Mover’s Distance
definition: A NeRF training method that uses a monocular depth prior (DiffDP) and its uncertainty to guide the ray termination distance distribution using Earth Mover's Distance (EMD), rather than directly supervising the rendered depth.
